limitations: All scores are provisional browser assessments based on attached screenshots and the supplied runtime narrative; underlying JSON and live behavior were not independently inspected.
Corresponding transition screenshots appear compositionally consistent, but still images cannot establish temporal continuity, press response or absence of layout shifts.
Reported runtime checks support interaction scores; screenshots alone do not prove activation, persistence, focus behavior or accessible semantics.
Below-viewport content and scrolled captures are not treated as inaccessible solely because they are cropped; reported layout checks do not replace independent scroll and focus testing.
No confirmed hard-gate failure is established by this material, but the all-screen and all-component A>=9 and F>=9 threshold is not met.
Physical iPhone Safari, VoiceOver, native Dynamic Type, keyboard behavior, microphone, haptics, real payments and OS share delivery remain unverified and are not certified.
Contrast checks reported for DOM text do not establish raster export-text contrast or readability at typical sharing sizes.
Synthetic forecast, source and stress wording is evaluated as layout material, not as production-copy defects or evidence of predictive quality.
Online Circles, production authentication and representative novice-use outcomes are not demonstrated by these screenshots.
topFixes: Tighten enlarged composer and date-form spacing so primary actions require less scrolling.
Clarify forecast check-in dates and use readable dates in profile and history.
Increase raster share-card qualification text and make the initial preview easier to inspect.
Consolidate duplicated notices and offline guidance, placing recovery explanations beside their actions.
Remove hard mist-image boundaries and partially visible text fragments beneath fixed headers.
Improve evidence-reader scanning and repeat the background-only qualification on the sources reader.
